Create a compact, meaningful, source-linked axiomatic interpretation of EVERY

INFERRED/AMBIGUOUS edges are not normative assertions. Cross-file graph nodes

Use stable snake_case keys derived from the named entity or rule, not line
numbers, chunk numbers, ordinal sequences or transient extraction IDs. All keys
are local to this call and globally unique across its five arrays. Relation
endpoints and constraint/latitude targets must be local concepts. Residual
subjects must be another local concept/relation/constraint/latitude. Source
repetition may motivate repeated local concepts; do not silently resolve

Every record needs at least one grounding entry: a supplied section_id, exact
absolute start/end line numbers inside that section, and an EXACT source quote
within those lines. Do not normalize spelling, punctuation or whitespace in
the quote. Grounded quotation proves source re-entry, not fidelity of the whole
authored statement. Ground separately when several sections justify a record.

Return one disposition for EACH supplied section_id with no duplicates:

- inapplicable: content outside this bounded interpretation, with source reason;

Retained/residual sections require at least one selected record grounded in
that section. Select every authored record in at least one disposition. An

limitations, omissions and unresolved cross-chunk dependencies in limitations.

Do not insert judgments, traversals or transformations merely to fill families.

[{"end_line":188,"heading":"REQ-L-GTL3-LANGUAGE-CAPABILITY-MODEL - GTL Language Capability Model/Subordinate Vocabulary","id":"urn:a-c:project:3267f8b99452db6ee9e5991cf3b117ab6b31b1323e90e18af7adc6546d9f0420/source/specification/requirements/gtl/REQ-L-GTL3-LANGUAGE-CAPABILITY-MODEL.md#REQ-L-GTL3-LANGUAGE-CAPABILITY-MODEL%20-%20GTL%20Language%20Capability%20Model%2FSubordinate%20Vocabulary","path":"specification/requirements/gtl/REQ-L-GTL3-LANGUAGE-CAPABILITY-MODEL.md","sha256":"36c87b522efbd99b71cb4b17df710742f3477a3de9994463162900881e5947c4","start_line":102,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_skills/.ai-workspace/work/T003_PROJECT_REPRESENTATION/abiogenesis-01/run/generation/corpus/specification/requirements/gtl/REQ-L-GTL3-LANGUAGE-CAPABILITY-MODEL.md","lines":[{"number":102,"text":"## Subordinate Vocabulary
"},{"number":103,"text":"
"},{"number":104,"text":"**language capability catalog**: A qualified index of GTL language
"},{"number":105,"text":"capabilities and their requirement traces. It is a review and validation aid.
"},{"number":106,"text":"It is not a runtime lookup registry and not traversal selection truth.
"},{"number":107,"text":"
"},{"number":108,"text":"**catalog**: A qualified index surface. The word catalog shall not stand alone
"},{"number":109,"text":"as authority. A catalog reference shall state whether it is a language
"},{"number":110,"text":"capability catalog, publication inventory, library index, conformance catalog,
"},{"number":111,"text":"consequence catalog, runtime registry query, or another named catalog family.
"},{"number":112,"text":"
"},{"number":113,"text":"**publication inventory**: A static GTL declaration or admission inventory that
"},{"number":114,"text":"proves a module, program, or bundle publishes the surfaces it claims. A
"},{"number":115,"text":"publication inventory may support conformance checks. It is not a live lookup
"},{"number":116,"text":"registry and not traversal selection truth.
"},{"number":117,"text":"
"},{"number":118,"text":"**runtime registry**: An ABG-owned admitted lookup concept over registered
"},{"number":119,"text":"runtime-eligible surfaces. A runtime registry may expose query results, but any
"},{"number":120,"text":"candidate choice that affects traversal shall become ABG-emitted selection
"},{"number":121,"text":"truth before it has runtime authority.
"},{"number":122,"text":"
"},{"number":123,"text":"**library**: A reusable publication set of declared graph functions, overlays,
"},{"number":124,"text":"candidate families, public starts, policies, or companion surfaces. A graph
"},{"number":125,"text":"function in a library is a reusable workflow function, not the whole product
"},{"number":126,"text":"program. A library may be upstream/system-owned or downstream/product-owned. A
"},{"number":127,"text":"library is not a runtime registry until ABG admits and projects its entries
"},{"number":128,"text":"into registry truth.
"},{"number":129,"text":"
"},{"number":130,"text":"**system library**: A GTL/ABG-owned library of generic graph functions and
"},{"number":131,"text":"related surfaces needed identically across multiple ODD domains. System
"},{"number":132,"text":"library entries shall be admitted through GTL/ABG authority and shall not be
"},{"number":133,"text":"reimplemented by downstream products as parallel system truth.
"},{"number":134,"text":"
"},{"number":135,"text":"**product library**: A downstream-owned GTL library of specialized graph
"},{"number":136,"text":"functions, overlays, policies, or candidate families. Product library entries
"},{"number":137,"text":"are lawful only when declared through GTL, admitted by ABG, and kept subordinate
"},{"number":138,"text":"to ABG runtime authority.
"},{"number":139,"text":"
"},{"number":140,"text":"**ledger**: An ABG-owned truth surface derived from emitted events, admitted
"},{"number":141,"text":"payloads, or replay-derived projection. A ledger shall not mean a product-local
"},{"number":142,"text":"mutable store, controller memory, or second authority over fold, residual,
"},{"number":143,"text":"admission, continuation, re-entry, or selection truth.
"},{"number":144,"text":"
"},{"number":145,"text":"**event stream**: The append-only runtime truth path used by ABG to record
"},{"number":146,"text":"admitted runtime facts. Runtime truth that affects traversal, closure,
"},{"number":147,"text":"selection, continuation, or re-entry shall not be replaced by query-local
"},{"number":148,"text":"calculation or product-local memory.
"},{"number":149,"text":"
"},{"number":150,"text":"**projection**: A replay-derived view over admitted truth. A projection may
"},{"number":151,"text":"join, render, classify, or summarize admitted facts. A projection shall not
"},{"number":152,"text":"invent runtime truth that was not admitted or emitted by its governing source
"},{"number":153,"text":"surface.
"},{"number":154,"text":"
"},{"number":155,"text":"**read model**: A consumer-facing query or interpretation surface over admitted
"},{"number":156,"text":"truth or projections. A read model may label domain meaning. It shall not
"},{"number":157,"text":"admit evidence, emit events, fold assurance, select traversal, close, continue,
"},{"number":158,"text":"or re-enter.
"},{"number":159,"text":"
"},{"number":160,"text":"**overlay row**: A GTL or conformance declaration row that declares or indexes
"},{"number":161,"text":"a program composition over graph functions, graph vectors, node types, starts,
"},{"number":162,"text":"roles, security, policy, proof obligations, plugin/result contracts, and
"},{"number":163,"text":"related metadata. An overlay row is not a traversal controller.
"},{"number":164,"text":"
"},{"number":165,"text":"**overlay frame**: An ABG runtime observation, pressure, or foldback contract
"},{"number":166,"text":"scoped to admitted runtime state. An overlay frame belongs to ABG runtime law
"},{"number":167,"text":"and is distinct from an overlay row.
"},{"number":168,"text":"
"},{"number":169,"text":"**selection event**: ABG-emitted truth recording a traversal-affecting
"},{"number":170,"text":"candidate choice. Selection may be preceded by queries, eligibility filters,
"},{"number":171,"text":"or ranking, but the runtime effect belongs to the emitted selection event.
"},{"number":172,"text":"
"},{"number":173,"text":"**candidate family**: A GTL-declared family of graph-function candidates that
"},{"number":174,"text":"share an explicit outer contract. Candidate-family membership does not select
"},{"number":175,"text":"a candidate for traversal.
"},{"number":176,"text":"
"},{"number":177,"text":"**public start**: A product-visible entry handle bound to a published graph
"},{"number":178,"text":"function. A public start is not a bare graph vector and does not own runtime
"},{"number":179,"text":"execution truth.
"},{"number":180,"text":"
"},{"number":181,"text":"**runtime lookup**: A query over admitted registry truth that returns lawful or
"},{"number":182,"text":"rejected candidates for a named situation. Runtime lookup may inform selection.
"},{"number":183,"text":"It does not become selection authority until ABG emits selection truth.
"},{"number":184,"text":"
"},{"number":185,"text":"**eligibility filter**: A deterministic ABG-owned filter over candidate
"},{"number":186,"text":"identity, interface, source and target contracts, context, authority, overlay,
"},{"number":187,"text":"namespace, version, provenance, readiness, proof, and policy constraints.
"},{"number":188,"text":"
"}]},{"end_line":367,"heading":"REQ-L-GTL3-LANGUAGE-CAPABILITY-MODEL - GTL Language Capability Model/Acceptance Criteria","id":"urn:a-c:project:3267f8b99452db6ee9e5991cf3b117ab6b31b1323e90e18af7adc6546d9f0420/source/specification/requirements/gtl/REQ-L-GTL3-LANGUAGE-CAPABILITY-MODEL.md#REQ-L-GTL3-LANGUAGE-CAPABILITY-MODEL%20-%20GTL%20Language%20Capability%20Model%2FAcceptance%20Criteria","path":"specification/requirements/gtl/REQ-L-GTL3-LANGUAGE-CAPABILITY-MODEL.md","sha256":"fc3411ae884981dfa02636bb91693d66c3221642794385e987f459d292de8a63","start_line":189,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_skills/.ai-workspace/work/T003_PROJECT_REPRESENTATION/abiogenesis-01/run/generation/corpus/specification/requirements/gtl/REQ-L-GTL3-LANGUAGE-CAPABILITY-MODEL.md","lines":[{"number":189,"text":"## Acceptance Criteria
"},{"number":190,"text":"
"},{"number":191,"text":"**REQ-L-GTL3-LANGUAGE-CAPABILITY-MODEL-001**: GTL shall publish one language
"},{"number":192,"text":"capability model that lets reviewers identify every language-level capability
"},{"number":193,"text":"without reading implementation source or downstream product conventions.
"},{"number":194,"text":"
"},{"number":195,"text":"**REQ-L-GTL3-LANGUAGE-CAPABILITY-MODEL-002**: The language capability model
"},{"number":196,"text":"shall distinguish GTL declaration capability from ABG runtime realization.
"},{"number":197,"text":"GTL may declare, constrain, compose, publish, and validate program law; ABG
"},{"number":198,"text":"owns admission, event truth, runtime ledgers, projection, fold, continuation,
"},{"number":199,"text":"re-entry, and traversal-affecting selection.
"},{"number":200,"text":"
"},{"number":201,"text":"**REQ-L-GTL3-LANGUAGE-CAPABILITY-MODEL-003**: Each GTL capability shall state
"},{"number":202,"text":"purpose, owner, authority boundary, source truth, admitted inputs, emitted
"},{"number":203,"text":"truth if any, projection outputs, query outputs, rejection taxonomy, readiness
"},{"number":204,"text":"gates, proof obligations, invariants, forbidden authority, and downstream
"},{"number":205,"text":"interpretation boundary.
"},{"number":206,"text":"
"},{"number":207,"text":"**REQ-L-GTL3-LANGUAGE-CAPABILITY-MODEL-004**: HOW design shall treat carrier
"},{"number":208,"text":"names, module boundaries, API spellings, event names, data structures, tests,
"},{"number":209,"text":"and proof artifacts as implementation bindings to WHAT. HOW design shall not
"},{"number":210,"text":"change ownership, authority, invariants, or semantic boundaries declared by
"},{"number":211,"text":"WHAT.
"},{"number":212,"text":"
"},{"number":213,"text":"**REQ-L-GTL3-LANGUAGE-CAPABILITY-MODEL-005**: A language capability catalog
"},{"number":214,"text":"shall be a qualified index of GTL capabilities and requirement traces. It
"},{"number":215,"text":"shall not be treated as a runtime registry, runtime lookup result, or
"},{"number":216,"text":"selection event.
"},{"number":217,"text":"
"},{"number":218,"text":"**REQ-L-GTL3-LANGUAGE-CAPABILITY-MODEL-006**: A publication inventory shall
"},{"number":219,"text":"prove declared publication scope only. It shall not be treated as a runtime
"},{"number":220,"text":"registry, runtime lookup result, or selection event.
"},{"number":221,"text":"
"},{"number":222,"text":"**REQ-L-GTL3-LANGUAGE-CAPABILITY-MODEL-007**: A runtime registry shall be an
"},{"number":223,"text":"ABG-owned admitted lookup concept. Runtime registry truth shall be derived from
"},{"number":224,"text":"declared and admitted entries, not from product-local lists, prompt prose,
"},{"number":225,"text":"manual scans, or controller memory.
"},{"number":226,"text":"
"},{"number":227,"text":"**REQ-L-GTL3-LANGUAGE-CAPABILITY-MODEL-008**: A system library shall contain
"},{"number":228,"text":"generic GTL/ABG-owned graph functions or companion surfaces that multiple ODD
"},{"number":229,"text":"domains need identically. Downstream products shall not republish a system
"},{"number":230,"text":"library function as parallel authority.
"},{"number":231,"text":"
"},{"number":232,"text":"**REQ-L-GTL3-LANGUAGE-CAPABILITY-MODEL-009**: A product library shall be
"},{"number":233,"text":"lawful when it declares product-specialized graph functions or companion
"},{"number":234,"text":"surfaces through GTL and ABG admits those entries. Product libraries shall not
"},{"number":235,"text":"bypass declaration, admission, provenance, proof, readiness, or ownership
"},{"number":236,"text":"checks.
"},{"number":237,"text":"
"},{"number":238,"text":"**REQ-L-GTL3-LANGUAGE-CAPABILITY-MODEL-010**: A product library shall not
"},{"number":239,"text":"shadow, replace, or override a system library entry unless explicit
"},{"number":240,"text":"refinement, override, or specialization law is declared and ABG eligibility
"},{"number":241,"text":"proof accepts it.
"},{"number":242,"text":"
"},{"number":243,"text":"**REQ-L-GTL3-LANGUAGE-CAPABILITY-MODEL-011**: A ledger shall be an ABG-owned
"},{"number":244,"text":"event or projection truth surface. A product-local mutable store shall not be
"},{"number":245,"text":"called a ledger when it would compete with ABG admission, event, fold,
"},{"number":246,"text":"residual, continuation, re-entry, registry, or selection truth.
"},{"number":247,"text":"
"},{"number":248,"text":"**REQ-L-GTL3-LANGUAGE-CAPABILITY-MODEL-012**: An event stream shall remain
"},{"number":249,"text":"the append-only truth path for runtime facts. Query-local calculation,
"},{"number":250,"text":"side-array return values, product-local files, or controller memory shall not
"},{"number":251,"text":"replace the event stream for traversal-affecting truth.
"},{"number":252,"text":"
"},{"number":253,"text":"**REQ-L-GTL3-LANGUAGE-CAPABILITY-MODEL-013**: A projection shall be
"},{"number":254,"text":"replay-derived from admitted source truth. A projection shall not create fold,
"},{"number":255,"text":"residual, registry, selection, continuation, or re-entry truth that its source
"},{"number":256,"text":"truth did not admit or emit.
"},{"number":257,"text":"
"},{"number":258,"text":"**REQ-L-GTL3-LANGUAGE-CAPABILITY-MODEL-014**: A read model shall be
"},{"number":259,"text":"read-only. It may interpret or label admitted truth for a consumer, but it
"},{"number":260,"text":"shall not emit events, admit evidence, fold assurance, select traversal, close,
"},{"number":261,"text":"continue, or re-enter.
"},{"number":262,"text":"
"},{"number":263,"text":"**REQ-L-GTL3-LANGUAGE-CAPABILITY-MODEL-015**: An overlay row shall be program
"},{"number":264,"text":"composition, catalog, publication, public-start, graph-function, graph-vector,
"},{"number":265,"text":"node-type, role, security, policy, proof-obligation, plugin/result-contract, or
"},{"number":266,"text":"related metadata. An overlay row shall not own runtime observation, pressure,
"},{"number":267,"text":"foldback, continuation, or selection authority.
"},{"number":268,"text":"
"},{"number":269,"text":"**REQ-L-GTL3-LANGUAGE-CAPABILITY-MODEL-015A**: GTL shall distinguish the
"},{"number":270,"text":"library/program/workspace abstraction boundary. Graph functions are reusable
"},{"number":271,"text":"library functions or callable work contracts. Graph overlays or GTL program
"},{"number":272,"text":"compositions are the program surfaces that bind those functions. Workspaces are
"},{"number":273,"text":"mutable instance surfaces that supply bootstrap config, files, data, observed
"},{"number":274,"text":"state, generated artifacts, and run archives. HoG traversal is the execution
"},{"number":275,"text":"bind over admitted program and workspace truth; ABG admits its runtime facts.
"},{"number":276,"text":"
"},{"number":277,"text":"**REQ-L-GTL3-LANGUAGE-CAPABILITY-MODEL-015B**: Overlays shall bind compositions
"},{"number":278,"text":"over graphs; graphs shall compose nested graph calls and declared computations
"},{"number":279,"text":"under the same HoG execution law. Reference-frame evaluation contracts shall
"},{"number":280,"text":"be reusable through existing composition, Context, contract and policy
"},{"number":281,"text":"declarations under `REQ-L-GTL3-CONTEXT-009..012`. First-class frame use shall not
"},{"number":282,"text":"introduce a separate topology object, callable kind, registry or interpreter.
"},{"number":283,"text":"The frame contract, overlay composition and ABG runtime Frame shall retain
"},{"number":284,"text":"their distinct meanings.
"},{"number":285,"text":"
"},{"number":286,"text":"**REQ-L-GTL3-LANGUAGE-CAPABILITY-MODEL-016**: An overlay frame shall be ABG
"},{"number":287,"text":"runtime contract truth over observed state, pressure, or foldback. An overlay
"},{"number":288,"text":"frame shall not be treated as a GTL publication inventory row or downstream
"},{"number":289,"text":"product controller.
"},{"number":290,"text":"
"},{"number":291,"text":"**REQ-L-GTL3-LANGUAGE-CAPABILITY-MODEL-017**: A candidate family shall
"},{"number":292,"text":"preserve one explicit outer contract across its candidates. Candidate-family
"},{"number":293,"text":"membership shall not select a candidate for traversal.
"},{"number":294,"text":"
"},{"number":295,"text":"**REQ-L-GTL3-LANGUAGE-CAPABILITY-MODEL-018**: A public start shall bind to a
"},{"number":296,"text":"published graph function. A public start shall not expose a bare graph vector
"},{"number":297,"text":"as product-visible runtime authority.
"},{"number":298,"text":"
"},{"number":299,"text":"**REQ-L-GTL3-LANGUAGE-CAPABILITY-MODEL-019**: Runtime lookup shall return
"},{"number":300,"text":"candidates or rejection diagnostics over admitted registry truth. Runtime
"},{"number":301,"text":"lookup shall not become traversal authority. A declared GTL selector or
"},{"number":302,"text":"attributed external decision proposes the selected identity, ABG admits that
"},{"number":303,"text":"identity as runtime truth, and HoG follows the admitted program relation.
"},{"number":304,"text":"
"},{"number":305,"text":"**REQ-L-GTL3-LANGUAGE-CAPABILITY-MODEL-020**: An eligibility filter shall
"},{"number":306,"text":"account for candidate identity, interface, source contracts, target contracts,
"},{"number":307,"text":"context, authority, overlay scope, namespace, version, provenance, readiness,
"},{"number":308,"text":"proof state, and policy refs before a candidate can be selected.
"},{"number":309,"text":"
"},{"number":310,"text":"**REQ-L-GTL3-LANGUAGE-CAPABILITY-MODEL-021**: A selection event shall be
"},{"number":311,"text":"ABG-admitted truth whenever candidate choice affects traversal. `F_D`, `F_P`,
"},{"number":312,"text":"or `F_H` ranking may propose selection only through the declared GTL boundary;
"},{"number":313,"text":"ABG validates and admits the resulting identity and HoG applies it. Neither ABG
"},{"number":314,"text":"nor the proposing implementation owns a hidden selection policy.
"},{"number":315,"text":"
"},{"number":316,"text":"**REQ-L-GTL3-LANGUAGE-CAPABILITY-MODEL-022**: Implementation-specific HOW
"},{"number":317,"text":"accounts, GTL-validator capability maps, and spec-vs-implementation gap
"},{"number":318,"text":"tables shall not be written into this requirement family. They are design or
"},{"number":319,"text":"commentary read models over the live requirement surface.
"},{"number":320,"text":"
"},{"number":321,"text":"**REQ-L-GTL3-LANGUAGE-CAPABILITY-MODEL-023**: A runtime registry design shall
"},{"number":322,"text":"be non-conformant if it is built from static publication inventory alone,
"},{"number":323,"text":"product-local configuration, prompt-only context, manual discovery, or
"},{"number":324,"text":"query-local candidate selection without admitted registry truth.
"},{"number":325,"text":"
"},{"number":326,"text":"**REQ-L-GTL3-LANGUAGE-CAPABILITY-MODEL-024**: Downstream domain semantics such
"},{"number":327,"text":"as software test, build, release, language toolchain, service protocol, or
"},{"number":328,"text":"product lifecycle policy shall not be promoted into GTL/ABG system-library
"},{"number":329,"text":"law. Such semantics belong in downstream product libraries, plugins, or read
"},{"number":330,"text":"models unless proven generic across ODD domains.
"},{"number":331,"text":"
"},{"number":332,"text":"**REQ-L-GTL3-LANGUAGE-CAPABILITY-MODEL-025**: Gap analysis shall classify
"},{"number":333,"text":"differences between WHAT and implementation as terminology gaps,
"},{"number":334,"text":"requirement gaps, design gaps, implementation gaps, proof gaps,
"},{"number":335,"text":"documentation gaps, or deferred runtime-registry gaps. Gap analysis shall not
"},{"number":336,"text":"replace live requirement truth.
"},{"number":337,"text":"
"},{"number":338,"text":"**REQ-L-GTL3-LANGUAGE-CAPABILITY-MODEL-026**: GTL shall provide one reusable
"},{"number":339,"text":"node-type capability for declaring named node contracts, binding nodes to
"},{"number":340,"text":"type refs, composing node types, checking type satisfaction, and composing
"},{"number":341,"text":"graph functions by endpoint type satisfaction.
"},{"number":342,"text":"
"},{"number":343,"text":"**REQ-L-GTL3-LANGUAGE-CAPABILITY-MODEL-027**: A node type shall be published
"},{"number":344,"text":"through the GTL library path as a non-callable node-type declaration with its
"},{"number":345,"text":"own typed identity and the `node_type` registry kind. It shall not mint or use
"},{"number":346,"text":"a `GraphFunction` identity, and no parallel type publication path is lawful.
"},{"number":347,"text":"
"},{"number":348,"text":"**REQ-L-GTL3-LANGUAGE-CAPABILITY-MODEL-028**: A `node_type` library entry may
"},{"number":349,"text":"be admitted, projected, imported, queried, and used by validator/conformance
"},{"number":350,"text":"surfaces. It shall not become runtime traversal work, public-start authority,
"},{"number":351,"text":"graph-call authority, or `graph_function_selected` truth.
"},{"number":352,"text":"
"},{"number":353,"text":"**REQ-L-GTL3-LANGUAGE-CAPABILITY-MODEL-029**: Type conformance shall be pure,
"},{"number":354,"text":"deterministic, replayable, and fail-closed. Unknown type refs, digest drift,
"},{"number":355,"text":"weakened schema, markov, context, asset-surface, authority, proof, or output
"},{"number":356,"text":"obligations shall reject rather than infer compatibility.
"},{"number":357,"text":"
"},{"number":358,"text":"**REQ-L-GTL3-LANGUAGE-CAPABILITY-MODEL-030**: Composed node types shall
"},{"number":359,"text":"preserve or strengthen every constituent node-type obligation. Composition
"},{"number":360,"text":"shall not weaken required schema, markov, asset-surface, authority, proof,
"},{"number":361,"text":"output, context, or provenance obligations.
"},{"number":362,"text":"
"},{"number":363,"text":"**REQ-L-GTL3-LANGUAGE-CAPABILITY-MODEL-031**: Type-sensitive graph-function
"},{"number":364,"text":"composition shall distinguish port identity from endpoint type contract. It
"},{"number":365,"text":"may connect differently named ports only when an explicit wiring or ratified
"},{"number":366,"text":"unambiguous auto-wiring proves the provided endpoint type satisfies the
"},{"number":367,"text":"required endpoint type.
"}]},{"end_line":9,"heading":"REQ-L-GTL3-LANGUAGE — Language Identity And Boundary","id":"urn:a-c:project:3267f8b99452db6ee9e5991cf3b117ab6b31b1323e90e18af7adc6546d9f0420/source/specification/requirements/gtl/REQ-L-GTL3-LANGUAGE.md#REQ-L-GTL3-LANGUAGE%20%E2%80%94%20Language%20Identity%20And%20Boundary","path":"specification/requirements/gtl/REQ-L-GTL3-LANGUAGE.md","sha256":"0e0e76f246131bf4c62dea8576e68a0febd15b9f7fdc20c0246612e68894cf50","start_line":1,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_skills/.ai-workspace/work/T003_PROJECT_REPRESENTATION/abiogenesis-01/run/generation/corpus/specification/requirements/gtl/REQ-L-GTL3-LANGUAGE.md","lines":[{"number":1,"text":"# REQ-L-GTL3-LANGUAGE — Language Identity And Boundary
"},{"number":2,"text":"
"},{"number":3,"text":"**Status**: Active - accepted by T-283 F_H closure

"},{"number":11,"text":"
"},{"number":12,"text":"Define GTL 3 as an LLM-first, graph-first, algebraic governance control
"},{"number":13,"text":"language with host-language-native typed declarative syntax and explicit
"},{"number":14,"text":"GTL-validator-HoG-ABG boundaries.
"},{"number":15,"text":"
"}]},{"end_line":49,"heading":"REQ-L-GTL3-LANGUAGE — Language Identity And Boundary/Acceptance Criteria","id":"urn:a-c:project:3267f8b99452db6ee9e5991cf3b117ab6b31b1323e90e18af7adc6546d9f0420/source/specification/requirements/gtl/REQ-L-GTL3-LANGUAGE.md#REQ-L-GTL3-LANGUAGE%20%E2%80%94%20Language%20Identity%20And%20Boundary%2FAcceptance%20Criteria","path":"specification/requirements/gtl/REQ-L-GTL3-LANGUAGE.md","sha256":"6a7c725bf14048ccedcf6e4957df0316aaead1d1ad013f7cad40a8764b41ddfe","start_line":16,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_skills/.ai-workspace/work/T003_PROJECT_REPRESENTATION/abiogenesis-01/run/generation/corpus/specification/requirements/gtl/REQ-L-GTL3-LANGUAGE.md","lines":[{"number":16,"text":"## Acceptance Criteria
"},{"number":17,"text":"
"},{"number":18,"text":"**REQ-L-GTL3-LANGUAGE-001**: GTL shall be an LLM-first, graph-first,
"},{"number":19,"text":"algebraic governance control language with host-language-native typed
"},{"number":20,"text":"declarative syntax.
"},{"number":21,"text":"
"},{"number":22,"text":"**REQ-L-GTL3-LANGUAGE-002**: Each conformant build tenant shall publish GTL as
"},{"number":23,"text":"an embedded typed declaration surface in its host language plus an equivalent
"},{"number":24,"text":"serialized admission carrier. GTL shall not require a separate free-form
"},{"number":25,"text":"programming syntax or parser family beyond those published contracts.
"},{"number":26,"text":"
"},{"number":27,"text":"**REQ-L-GTL3-LANGUAGE-003**: GTL shall be declarative. It shall declare lawful structure, contracts, hook attachment points, and semantic work surfaces rather than constructive tactics or hidden strategy.
"},{"number":28,"text":"
"},{"number":29,"text":"**REQ-L-GTL3-LANGUAGE-004**: GTL constructs shall be directly traversable by
"},{"number":30,"text":"conformant executor frameworks. HoG is the ABIogenesis executor. ABG is the
"},{"number":31,"text":"runtime-truth substrate around execution, not a second language or executor.
"},{"number":32,"text":"
"},{"number":33,"text":"**REQ-L-GTL3-LANGUAGE-005**: GTL owns language law, programs, graph structure,
"},{"number":34,"text":"contracts, algebra, and declared seams. The GTL validator owns non-lowering
"},{"number":35,"text":"whole-program judgment. HoG owns direct traversal. ABG owns runtime admission,
"},{"number":36,"text":"events, replay, lineage, provenance, correction, continuation, and closure.
"},{"number":37,"text":"
"},{"number":38,"text":"**REQ-L-GTL3-LANGUAGE-006**: GTL shall not define a specialized in-language policy semantic language. It shall expose hook attachment points and opaque configuration only.
"},{"number":39,"text":"
"},{"number":40,"text":"**REQ-L-GTL3-LANGUAGE-007**: GTL shall remain graph-function-first, composition-first, recursion-capable, higher-order, engine-agnostic, and governance-visible without prescribing constructive tactics.
"},{"number":41,"text":"
"},{"number":42,"text":"**REQ-L-GTL3-LANGUAGE-008**: GTL shall not be a planner, business-priority engine, hidden strategy selector, runtime event model, concrete worker-identity store, backend-specific transport language, or step-by-step solution procedure for probabilistic workers.
"},{"number":43,"text":"
"},{"number":44,"text":"**REQ-L-GTL3-LANGUAGE-009**: GTL shall use strong typed axioms and
"},{"number":45,"text":"validator-visible contract law as its anti-drift mechanism for LLM-authored
"},{"number":46,"text":"programs. Graph, program, start, implementation, result-interface, catalog,
"},{"number":47,"text":"carrier, traversal, and bind declarations shall produce typed validity, typed
"},{"number":48,"text":"invalidity, or typed unresolved semantics without lowering into an executable
"},{"number":49,"text":"intermediate program.
"}]},{"end_line":9,"heading":"REQ-L-GTL3-LAWS — Language Laws","id":"urn:a-c:project:3267f8b99452db6ee9e5991cf3b117ab6b31b1323e90e18af7adc6546d9f0420/source/specification/requirements/gtl/REQ-L-GTL3-LAWS.md#REQ-L-GTL3-LAWS%20%E2%80%94%20Language%20Laws","path":"specification/requirements/gtl/REQ-L-GTL3-LAWS.md","sha256":"68bd18cbfde846f58447111446e477fc33997c3367c099fe7184f3b41c6fc731","start_line":1,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_skills/.ai-workspace/work/T003_PROJECT_REPRESENTATION/abiogenesis-01/run/generation/corpus/specification/requirements/gtl/REQ-L-GTL3-LAWS.md","lines":[{"number":1,"text":"# REQ-L-GTL3-LAWS — Language Laws
